Both suites pass fully. I did not commit, per the task instructions.

## Summary

`smysl fmt` was re-parsing the freshly-formatted text on every run to guard against `write_surface` moving a record or label. In `src/main.rs:952-960` I gated that reparse on `formatted != src`: when the output is byte-identical to the input, it's literally the same string `parse_surface` already read to produce `out`, so a second parse can only reconfirm what's already known — skipping it turns the common case (`fmt --check` on an already-canonical tree, or a repeated `fmt --write`) into one parse instead of two, while the guard still runs in full whenever the writer actually changes the text.

Also updated:
- `tests/cmd_fmt.rs`: refreshed the round-trip-guard commentary and added a test pinning both branches (`formatted == src` fast path, `formatted != src` guarded path).
- `Documentation/manual/ch04-05-creating-formatting.typ`: updated the round-trip guarantee section's code snippet and prose to match.
- `CHANGELOG.md`: added an Unreleased entry describing the change.

`cargo test -q -p smysl --tests --no-fail-fast` and `cargo test -q -p smysl-core --no-fail-fast` both pass.
